scoring_justification: T1/T2 infeasible because the headline values are final scalar outputs from a full DFT pipeline; no richer raw artifact available for recompute within the verifier. Scoring compares reported values to paper gold with tolerances and verifies structural properties (list length, ordering).

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for band gaps, in-gap state energy, and absorption peak energies from the target paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper abstract and results: perfect gap 3.3 eV, defect gap 2.8 eV, in-gap state 1.7 eV, absorption peaks [1.72, 2.16, 2.81, 3.01, 3.36, 3.70, 4.00] eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from paper text and figures; consistent with the reference solve.sh output.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own reported computed results, serving as the hidden reference against which the agent's reproductions are compared.

outputs.description: Computed band gaps in eV for the perfect PbWO4 supercell and the defect supercell containing V_Pb^2-.
Computed energy in eV of the O 2p-derived in-gap state relative to the valence band maximum.
List of seven computed absorption peak photon energies in eV, extracted from the 1–4.5 eV spectral range.

output_contract.notes: All files must be placed in /app/outputs. The hidden verifier will check file existence, JSON validity, data types, array length, and compare reported values against a hidden reference.

steps.description: Verify band gap values are within tolerance of paper reference.
Verify in-gap state energy within tolerance.
Verify absorption peak energies; must be 7 sorted floats, within 0.2 eV of reference peaks. Full credit if max deviation <=0.1 eV, linear decay to 0 at 0.3 eV.
